text:
jia: heads up - saw a crash in the Go sampleapp stream handler when customers do tight reconnects behind our LB. Sequence: client reconnects, gets [DONE], connection closed, then a late chunk with a partial JSON arrives and json.Unmarshal fails. repro on go-sample + envoy. anyone else?

oren: paste the raw stream if you have it.

jia: yea — from tcpdump at the LB: 

data: {"mid":1,"text":"start"}
data: {"mid":2,"text":"cont"}
data: [DONE]
data: {"mid":2,"text":"!"}

marta: envoy can buffer/flush when TLS sessions close; the late packet may be a small tail that gets emitted after FIN. we've seen reorder-ish effects before.

sam: Go SDK's stream parser currently treats any data after [DONE] as fatal. we should make it tolerant like the JS fix.

oren: agree on tolerance. but we should also add a small defensive parse step: if a post-DONE line is non-empty, log it + drop instead of panicking. add a metric (stream.post_done_dropped).

jia: implemented a quick patch locally: drop+metric and tests. fixes sampleapp. opening issue for parity across SDKs.

marta: infra follow-up: can we configure LB to flush consistently on close? If TLS shutdown delays tail flushes, that might be prod-impacting. I'll open INFRA ticket.

ci-bot: Issue created: #5123 - "Go sampleapp: tolerate stray SSE chunks after [DONE]; add metric" (reported by jia)

oren: cross-SDK task please: replicate drop-behaviour in python/java/rust and add e2e in sampleapp that simulates envoy tail flush by writing a late chunk after close.

sam: will draft a brief README note in onboarding: "Rapid reconnects behind some LBs/proxies can surface late fragments; SDKs now drop stray post-DONE events to avoid parse errors."

jia: thanks — short-term UX fixed, infra will investigate TLS/LB behavior for a longer-term solution.
